QuestInfo.name: Old Gladius
QuestInfo.1: I visited #b#p502##k again, whom I'd first met in #m10004000#, when making the medicine for #p207# of #m10001000#. Surprised at how much stronger I've become, #p502# asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who ended up dying in Manji's place. Ever since then, Manji has held onto Tristan's sword. However, the blade was so corrupted by Balrog that it's almost too worn down to even be called a sword anymore...\n#p502# handed me the #b#t1302009##k that he'd held onto all these years and asked me to reawaken its true form. Once fully awakened, it will become the #b#t1302014##k. #p502# told me to begin with seeking out #b#p602##k in #b#m10005000##k.
QuestInfo.2: I met #b#p602##k in #b#m10005000##k and was able to ask him how to awaken the #b#t1302009##k.

0.0: Who's bothering me now... Hey!! You have a knack for annoying me, even at the best of times... Well, that's all right. If you have indeed gotten that much stronger, then I'd like to see it firsthand. Did you put the #t4031010# to good use? Well, it's all in the past, so...
0.1: I would like you to help me out. Of course, I could take care of it myself, but I can't leave this area. What do you think...? You seem to have gotten strong enough to handle it easily... Will you take a crack at it?

yes.0: Good choice. A few decades ago, I went into a huge cave in the middle of this island. In there, I felt this force of evil only I could feel, and I was sucked into it, following it deeper into the cave... I felt a sense of danger inside, but that didn't stop me from walking further into the cave.
yes.1: By the time I regained consciousness, everything around me was blue. And in the middle of darkness I saw a pair of piercing eyes staring at me. He was... yeah, the mythical, legendary Balrog. Possessing a huge set of wings and teeth so sharp they could cut through anything...
yes.2: I've spent all my life fighting, but his presence was undeniably overwhelming. My mind was telling me it was impossible to beat him, but he was already right in front of me. His weighty tail went up, high up... and starting moving towards me!
yes.3: Right at that second, someone stood in its way. This man, with a mysterious aura around his sword, fought Balrog head on, allowing me to escape. After rescuing me, he was struck by Balrog and fell. He was... yes, the legendary hero Tristan.
yes.4: I went to him... but he didn't look like he had much of a chance. Before it was too late, he handed me the #b#t1302009##k, worn out by the sheer evil of Balrog, and then passed away. This is that same sword right here. I would love to restore this to its original state.
yes.5: The sword becomes #b#t1302014##k once it is reawakened. However, as for the details of how to reawaken it, I have no idea. I think you have to eliminate the evil force of Balrog, though... You should go see #b#p602##k from #b#m10005000##k and ask about it.

no.0: Hah... You must be still holding on to the fact that I thought nothing of you before... You can't catch up to me with that mindset! Now, I'm not so sure if I'll accept you, even if you do change your mind... hahah.

1.0: #b#t1302009##k... A few decades ago, when I found out that Tristan had passed away, I couldn't believe my ears. I was the one that made the #b#t1302014##k for him. I thought anyone worthy of possessing that sword would have been indestructible. I heard that the sword has since gone bad... has it gone old and rusty?

yes.0: I will be waiting for you here.

npc.0: I want you to awaken the #b#t1302009##k that I gave you into #b#t1302014##k. #r#p602##k of #m10005000# may know how to do it. If you return the reawakened sword to me... I'll definitely reward you for your hard work. Let's see if you can do this...

item.0: You want to know how to awaken a sword? But which sword are you talking about? Don't tell me you've lost it...

lost.0: You lost the #b#t1302009##k I gave you? You fool! But even your mistake worked out in my favor--I happened to pick up what you dropped. I can't believe I trusted someone like you with such a precious sword... Don't lose it again.
